structure.physical: elements 1-5 map to the 12 signs (sign -> element)
structure.transcendent: element 9 activates for every sovereign member at Stage 9
structure.nested: each of the 9 elements is a 9x9x9x9x9 domain (5 nested nine-fold layers)

elements.name: FIRE
elements.domain: The initiating element. Drives the Mastery axis; governs gaming, conquest, leadership.

elements.name: WATER
elements.domain: The deep element. Governs family, bloodline, and the subconscious layers of the matrix.

elements.name: WIND
elements.domain: The communication element. Carries knowledge across all dimensions of the Order.

elements.name: METAL
elements.domain: The endurance element. Governs physical reserves, long-game economics, structural legacy.

elements.name: SAND
elements.domain: The universal amplifier -- strengthens every element around it.

elements.name: SOUL
elements.domain: The identity element. Governs the deep self, the character system, and the genealogy tree.

elements.name: SPACE
elements.domain: The expansion element. Governs prediction, the Oracle, and inter-dimensional matrix reach.

elements.name: VOID
elements.domain: The destruction element. Removes blockages and opens the highest gates by eliminating resistance.

elements.name: THE NINTH
elements.domain: Religion, character, mind, heart, birth, death, life, family, work, friends. The ultimate element, active for all at Stage 9.
